caps.name: agents:read
caps.label: See agents
caps.sentence: See the agents in {where}: their names, whether they're working, and whether they need you.

caps.name: presence:read
caps.label: See who is looking
caps.sentence: See who else is looking at those agents.

caps.name: thread:read
caps.label: Read the Thread
caps.sentence: Read your conversations with the agents in {where}, including each one's last message.

caps.name: thread:post
caps.label: Post to the Thread
caps.sentence: Send messages to the agents in {where} as you, with files you pick.

caps.name: sources:read
caps.label: Read data sources
caps.sentence: Read the data sources this card names, on the servers you're signed in to. With thread:post or store:write too, what it shows can reach agents.

caps.name: gardens:template
caps.label: Turn this Garden into a built-in page

caps.name: files:read
caps.label: Read files (also shows heartbeat instructions)
caps.sentence: Read files in the agents' rooms on this computer (the room's files, never a path outside it).

caps.name: tickets:read
caps.label: Read tickets and get live ticket updates
caps.sentence: Read the tickets in the agents' rooms on this computer, with their comments.

caps.name: tickets:post
caps.label: Open, answer, assign and set status on tickets
caps.sentence: Open tickets for the agents on this computer, comment on them and set their status, as you.

caps.name: store:read
caps.label: Read the workspace store
caps.sentence: Read this widget's own data on this computer.

caps.name: store:write
caps.label: Change dump-table rows
caps.sentence: Save this widget's own data on this computer. Agents you allow can read and change it too.

caps.name: guests:rooms
caps.label: Set its own guests' rooms (an owner grant per App, never a guest's)
caps.sentence: See and change which rooms an App's guests can reach on this computer. Every change asks you first, outside the widget.

caps.name: activity:read
caps.label: See when the agent is working
caps.sentence: See when the agents on this computer are working (no tool names, text or paths).

caps.name: heartbeats:read
caps.label: See heartbeats: schedule, next fire, history

caps.name: heartbeats:write
caps.label: Add, edit, turn on or off, archive and fire heartbeats

caps.name: agent:identity
caps.label: Change the agent's name, color and picture

caps.name: files:agentconfig
caps.label: Also allow writing the agent's .k2 folder (not recommended)

caps.name: room:members
caps.label: See who has access to the room
caps.sentence: See who has access to the agents on this computer: the App guests and agent logins with a grant on each room, and their roles.

caps.name: project:write
caps.label: Post in project chats (needs it in every member room)

caps.name: wallet:self
caps.label: Use the person's own wallet (an owner setting per App, never a room cap)

errors.doc: The verb's cap isn't one this widget asked for in its manifest (or isn't a widget cap).
The address isn't one of the agents this widget reaches (this computer's agents and your Homes' rows).
Over a per-widget budget (calls, subscriptions, live servers, gardens.switch).
A message or argument is over its size limit.
No such verb in the catalog.
No implementation is registered, or the server lacks the row's feature.
A Garden-only verb called from an App. Never happens in a Garden.
A catalog verb that isn't exposed to this caller (zen.exit, controls.bind, homes.list, …).
Posting is paused: the runaway guard tripped (too many posts). The person resumes it on the widget.
The source's server isn't one of your saved servers (Settings → Network → Connected Servers).
The source's server didn't answer. The error carries `last`: the last view K2 has, with phase stale.
The source was removed on its server (its name is held for 7 days).
The source keeps states only, so it has no history.
The call failed; the message says why.
The key changed since you read it (ifRev didn't match); read it again and retry.
This widget's data is full (20 MiB or 100,000 keys; saves 5 MiB or 10,000).
A value is at most 60 KiB of JSON; use putChunked for bigger text.
A key is 1-256 bytes of letters, digits and . _ ~ : @ + / -, with no leading /, .. or empty segment.
The widget's maker has no grant for this key (an agent-made widget uses its maker's grants).
The change cursor is older than kept history; list again.
Nobody signed this widget version: run k2 zen validate --widget <name>, or click It's mine.
The widget's code changed under it; the frame reloads.
Garden data on this computer is full (512 MiB).
No such transaction for this widget.
The transaction expired (30 s idle, or the daemon restarted); start again.
Too many open transactions; finish or abort one.
This widget is paused for too many identical writes; the person can resume it.
An argument isn't plain data (functions, DOM nodes and cycles never cross) or the call's arguments aren't a list. The frame refuses it before it leaves; K2 refuses it too.
K2 delivered a value that isn't the verb's shape (a card view without items, say). The runtime's guard refuses it to a handler-object subscription; the widget keeps its last good data.
No pass on an App call: send this App's pass (K2_PASS_FILE) or a guest's session pass as Authorization: Bearer.
The pass is unknown, expired or revoked: read K2_PASS_FILE again (K2 rotates it), or log the guest in again.
A pass for another App or link was presented on this App's gateway link.
The route isn't open to Apps (no app row in the catalog).
An App's write sends Content-Type: application/json.
The pass doesn't hold that room: the same answer as a room that doesn't exist.
A missing or bad argument; the hint says which.
Nothing by that name in a room the pass holds (ticket, note, row, heartbeat, pinned Chat).
Wrong username, email or password, or no access to this App.
Too many wrong passwords: the login is locked for retryAfterSecs seconds.
The card was already answered, voided or expired.
Server SDK: a call with no guest bound; bind one (asGuest, withGuest) or write asApp().
Server SDK: asApp() where this App has no pass file (K2_PASS_FILE).
Server SDK: users and rooms need the App key ($K2_SECRETS_DIR/K2_APP_KEY; the owner mints it with k2 app key mint).
Sew: this guest has no chat access (a grant of kind chat).
Sew is not enabled or not reachable on this server, or its chat-pass keys are unavailable.
Guest rooms: only this App's own pass (its link pass or remote pass) calls this; never a guest's pass, the owner token or a login.
Guest rooms: the owner hasn't granted this App guests:rooms (k2 app grant <app> --kind guests-rooms).
Guest rooms: a room this App may not hand out (or one that doesn't exist: the same answer).
Guest rooms: a room the guest's role doesn't cover; rooms never add caps beyond the role.
Guest rooms: the guest's grant on this App carries a role, so its rooms are the role's; give a narrower role.
A Garden write that needs the person's confirm on K2's sheet, outside the frame.
The person said no on K2's confirm sheet.
Device sign-in: the refresh token is unknown, ended, expired or for another App; sign in again.
Device sign-in: a refresh token came back after it was used; that device is signed out (sign in again).
Wallet verbs need an App user's own login session pass. Connect logins, the owner token, agent passports and an App's own pass have no wallet.
This App doesn't use personal wallets; its owner turns them on.
The person already has an item with that label for that provider.
